Q1.text: Users consistently decline the location permission. The screen asks for it before explaining anything. What is the strongest next move?

choices.text: Add a short line explaining the permission at the top of the screen
choices.reveal: The added line helps slightly, but users still tap decline when the prompt appears before they reach the feature that needs it.

choices.text: Move the permission request to the moment the location feature is first used, with a one-line benefit statement
choices.reveal: Requests made in context are accepted far more often, because the reason for the permission is self-evident at that moment.

choices.text: Escalate the permission screen to the design-system team for a redesign
choices.reveal: The design-system team confirms the pattern is fine; the problem is where in the flow the prompt appears, not how it looks.
